introP1: At Nieuwe Instituut, we believe in the power of collaboration and shared knowledge. Join us and contribute to a vibrant and inspiring collection.
introP2: Do you have a passion for archives, research, and the collection of the Nieuwe Instituut? Do you want to share your knowledge and insights with a broader audience? The Collection Platform is a place to contribute to knowledge sharing.
howTo1: Write an article: Whether you are an expert, a student, or an enthusiast, we welcome articles that have a link to the collection. These can range from in-depth analyses to personal reflections or a visual story.
howTo2: Share your research: Are you working on interesting research related to the subjects within the collection? Share your findings and help enrich our platform with new perspectives.
howTo3: Tell your story: Do you have an intriguing story related to the collection? Whether it’s a historical fact, a personal experience, or a vision for the future, your story deserves a place on the Collection Platform.
guidelines1: Relevance: Ensure your contribution has a clear link to our collection and the themes we address.
guidelines2: Originality: We value original content. Plagiarism is not allowed.
guidelines3: Quality: Keep your texts clear, well-structured, and free of grammatical errors.
guidelines4: Responsibility: There is no final editing process. Your story is truly yours. Therefore, keep in mind that there is no fact-checking and that your name will be associated with the story.
why1: Reach a wide audience: Your work will be read by a diverse group of people interested in architecture, design, and digital culture.
why2: Expand your network: By publishing on our platform, you get the chance to connect with other professionals and enthusiasts in your field.
why3: Support knowledge sharing: You contribute to increasing knowledge and appreciation for the disciplines we cherish at Nieuwe Instituut.
whySection1: Send your proposal or article to
whySection2: and our team will get in touch with you. We look forward to receiving your contributions and making our Collection Platform even richer and more diverse together!
